description: Convert audio between MP3, OGG, Opus, M4A, WAV and FLAC with control of bitrate, sample rate and channels; cut a part, add fades, and normalize loudness to a LUFS target under a true-peak ceiling, keeping the dynamics. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Media tools: Video and audio chores for sites, apps and docs: turn a clip into a small GIF or animated WebP, compress video to web-ready MP4/WebM with a poster, pull thumbnails and a contact sheet, extract or convert audio with loudness normalization, draw waveforms, and probe a file for what will not play in browsers..

audio.description: Audio file as base64 (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC), or a video to take the sound from.

bitrateKbps.description: For mp3, ogg, opus and m4a. A sensible default per format when omitted.

duration.description: How many seconds to keep. To the end when omitted.

normalize.description: Bring loudness to the target level (two-pass, no pumping).

targetLufs.description: Loudness target when normalize is on: -16 for web and podcasts, -14 for music platforms, -23 for broadcast.

name: media_tools_audio_convert
